kind_note: Append-only starting, running, and terminal lines share a launch_id. The starting row is protected before spawn; the running row adds PID identity. Brief, task, stage and argv digests bind a stage delegation to its active contract; lite-fix rows set mode=lite and key task to the open window id. Authoritative rows and locks live in Git's protected control directory; .factory/delegations.jsonl is a diagnostic mirror. Per-task and shared-state locks serialize writers; PID start identity prevents reuse mistakes, unverified reused groups are never signalled, and trusted-command cleanup reaps the process group plus descendants observed through a post-exit quiet window. Print-only diagnostics never create a record.
